scope: Native LOITER-assisted pilot input and bounded assisted scenarios; not ACRO or physical-controller qualification

cases.acceptance: Immutable run/epoch/boot/operator/generation/source/sequence/Android clock, pointer state, axes and receipt timestamps bind each input. UI producer and native sender clocks are distinct observations. A stationary held UI pointer may be sampled, but sender must never restamp old input as new. ADB/root touch and scripts are labelled, not human/HID proof.

Discovery alone cannot grant. Explicit consent and fresh neutral bind context; fresh input can renew a bounded lease according to declared policy. Foreign context/source, duplicate/reordered/stale input, clock offset/regression, pointerUP/CANCEL/background fail closed; revoke cannot silently restore.

Single native sender; durable intent and input-to-wire SHA/context binding before wire. Recheck input age/lease/profile immediately at send callback. Block stale/foreign target/type/sequence and malformed axes; unknown send and fsync failure cannot become SENT or be retried.

Multiple distinct fresh input samples drive continuous observed RC override packets. Stale last sample is not resent as fresh. Expiry/CANCEL/revoke stops further stick output and uses only the dedicated bounded release path if possible; unsent or unknown release is not called delivered/neutralized.

Observe exact4.7.1/dbe79216 target42/1 and current typed arming/failsafe/RC mapping/calibration parameters. ARMING_SKIPCHK0 skips none. FS_OPTIONS bit4 must not suppress GCS action in LOITER. RC_OVERRIDE_TIME finite and GCS timeout/action declared per profile; disabled checks/failsafes cannot PASS.

Takeoff blocked until actual armed observation, fresh post-arm Home candidate and explicit exact candidate confirmation with raw coordinates/MSL datum/time/boot/generation. Home change/reboot/expiry invalidates confirmation; no tolerant or automatic reseal.
GUIDED/ARM/3m takeoff and Hold accepted from independent raw mode/armed/position/land-state observations over time. ACK or command write never proves motion, hover or ground.

LOITER assistance labelled; actual nonzero input-to-wire bindings precede observed horizontal motion with correct declared axis direction. Explicit neutral/release/Hold observations show bounded stop; no motor-output/ACRO claim.
LAND request plus observed landing mode/vertical motion, on-ground extended state and disarmed heartbeats under declared freshness/continuity. Local socket close/elapsed time are not safe landing.

Cut only Android-native MAVLink path while nonzero input is active; preserve FDM/clock/AP/passive observation. Root pressing graceful CLOSE or cutting whole Docker networking is not the intended fault. No automatic reconnect or GCS heartbeat restoration before failsafe observation.

Passive application-layer MAVLinkTX0 (TCP handshake/ACK traffic is not MAVLink payload). Observe airborne state when lastGCSheartbeat timeout expires, configured AP action and terminal ground/disarm or UNKNOWN. Landing caused earlier by RC fallback cannot alone prove GCS failsafe.

Observe ground/disarmed before killing/restarting AP; owned new process/executable identity and new AP epoch/boot. Require complete new discovery/profile and fresh consent/neutral before any control; old input/lease/callback or persisted history never regains authority. Airborne reboot mock-only.

All admitted host/model/AP frames and exact timing are retained, current clock/chain/cold anchors checked; partial prefixes and post-SENT stage failure counts remain truthful. Root owned resources close and failed attempts remain distinct.
Entry20GiB/floor10GiB+256MiB/real15s prime and forecast, speedup1/cap500ms unchanged. Previous1651-file handoff/source/candidate/ENDURE immutable; no QA launches/APK sign/product edit.

notSufficientForPass: GCS enabled flag without FS_OPTIONS semantics
observer receiving bytes without zeroTX proof
on-ground after RC fallback without airborne-at-GCS-timeout evidence
old input resampled by network timer
